facts.item: who brought her to the hospital
facts.text: My brother brought me to the emergency department because of the chest pain.

facts.item: recent loss of a loved one
facts.text: My husband died recently in a car accident.
I'm grieving and I'm still in shock over losing him. I'm very distressed.
I don't have any significant medical problems.
I've never had a problem with alcohol or drugs.

x005: The source reports an S3 and also 'no ... gallops'; an S3 is a gallop. Both kept as given.

source_issues: Cardiovascular exam contradicts itself: 'Presence of S3 heart sound' vs 'No murmurs, rubs, or gallops detected'.
Troponin and BNP leaves contain no results, only speculation ('Levels not mentioned, but the context suggests possible normal or slightly elevated'; 'Not mentioned, but can be useful in context').
The echocardiogram describes left ventricular and atrial enlargement, not the apical ballooning typical of the gold diagnosis; the ECG is reported as normal.
notes: 'Recently widowed' (Social_History) merges with the husband's death in the History (f005); grief, shock and 'Emotional distress' (p003) are one fact (f006).
Troponin and BNP are excluded (no result, speculative text); a doctor ordering them gets 'unavailable'.
Only a denial of alcohol or drug abuse is recorded (f009); whether she drinks at all is not stated.

excluded_exam_lines.reason: Troponin: no result in the source ('Levels not mentioned, but the context suggests possible normal or slightly elevated'); speculative text, not a result.
BNP: no result in the source ('Not mentioned, but can be useful in context'); commentary, not a result.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with severe chest pain.
